title: Mar Mattai, Jerwan & Faida Reliefs
full_text:
After breakfast, we'll drive to the 4th-century Monastery of Mar Mattei, located high on a mountain.
We'll explore the historic site and enjoy the panoramic views.*
Visiting Jerwan, an aqueduct in the middle of Nineveh Plains
Visiting Faida, a mountain relief recently discovered on the mountains close to Duhok, part of the larger Aqueduct system within the region
Arriving at Duhok and having Lunch there.
